page_title: CEL 3-0 RAY | Celta Vigo v Rayo Vallecano 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Augusto Batalla makes a great save to stop his effort.
90+2' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
89' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:12. The current number of shots on goal is 6:3.
84' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
83' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Carl Starfelt will be replaced by Hugo Burcio (Celta Vigo).
79' 3 - 0 Goal! Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:0.

79' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
79' Here is a change. Isi Palazon is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
78' Today's match ends for Jorge de Frutos who will be replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
76' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
71' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Mingueza.
71' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Javier Rodriguez and he is replaced by Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo).
70' CHANCE! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
68' Carlos Martin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jozhua Vertrouwd (Rayo Vallecano).
66' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano). He’s got to go!
66' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts to discuss the decision with Mateo Busquets, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
65' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets a yellow card, off the field.

65' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano), but referee Mateo Busquets must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
65' The referee can't ignore those comments and Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card for bad language.
64' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
63' Substitution. Hugo Sotelo makes his way off the pitch and Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) comes on as his replacement.
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hugo Alvarez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
61' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Pacha is replaced by Alemao (Rayo Vallecano).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gerard Gumbau trots off the pitch and is replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
59' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
58' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
58' The attendance for today's match is 20835.
54' 2 - 0 Goal! Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Augusto Batalla into the bottom left corner.
54' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo have been awarded a penalty kick!
50' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.

48' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ionut Radu makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
48' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.
40' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Hugo Alvarez laid the ball off to Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
40' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
37' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
33' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
32' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
32' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.

29' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Augusto Batalla shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
26' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
25' A snap shot from distance by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
25' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
25' The corner from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence.

24' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom left corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Augusto Batalla.
24' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' The corner from Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Augusto Batalla.
19' A corner kick by Rayo Vallecano is thwarted by the well prepared Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo).
16' The corner from Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) is hurriedly cleared.
15' Lovely run from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
10' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Celta Vigo will kick-off.
Mateo Busquets is introduced as the referee for today's match.
